# Statuettes. Small Sculpture at Home

[More info & Tickets](https://www.muzee.be/en/statuettes-small-sculpture-at-home-- 'Statuettes. Small Sculpture at Home')

## Mu.ZEE and its collection

Mu.ZEE is the only place in the world that focuses on modern and contemporary art in Belgium, from 1880 to tomorrow. Mu.ZEE would like to share its iconic building, its beautiful collection and the growing knowledge about it with you and as many others as possible. In a warm, welcoming and generous manner. An evolving yet constant museum embodying the pleasure of collecting. 
During our temporary closure, starting in January 2025, Mu.ZEE's collection will be showcased in various other locations, so you can continue to enjoy our art elsewhere. 
Mu.ZEE wants to let everyone enjoy, and obtain an insight into, the fascinating, unfinished story of art in Belgium, artist by artist. Bringing people from far and wide, both for the 'mu' and the 'sea' in our name. How wonderful!

[More info](https://www.muzee.be/en/to-see)

Venetiaanse Gaanderijen

Event

# A COSY CHRISTMAS AT THE MUSEUM

There is plenty to see and do at Designmuseum Danmark in December. You can view this year’s Christmas table by Skov Studio, make wooden Christmas decorations with the family, explore two newly opened exhibitions and take a break in the café with the flavours of the season.

[Read more](https://designmuseum.dk/en/a-festive-christmas-at-the-design-museum/)

[A COSY CHRISTMAS AT THE MUSEUM link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/a-festive-christmas-at-the-design-museum/ 'A COSY CHRISTMAS AT THE MUSEUM link')

September 18 2026 — February 21 2027

# Henrik Vibskov: The Exhibition

This major exhibition focuses on Vibskov’s special way of working and features a wealth of different works and experiences – from tiny models of installations and 44 display cases with objects, prototypes and works from Vibskov’s studio to large-scale installations that visitors can move through.

[Read more](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/henrik-vibskov/)

[Henrik Vibskov: The Exhibition link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/henrik-vibskov/ 'Henrik Vibskov: The Exhibition link')

NEW EXHIBITION ABOUT DANISH DESIGN

# DANISH MODERN

Danish design is known and loved – both at home and abroad. But what led to its success, which designs are central, and who are the major Danish designers of the 20th century? The exhibition 'Danish Modern' unfolds the story of Danish design from the 1920s to the 1970s, focusing on the creation of some of the most iconic Danish design objects.

[Read more](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/danish-modern/)

[DANISH MODERN link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/exhibition/danish-modern/ 'DANISH MODERN link')

MUSEUM

# EXPERIENCE VERNER PANTON CLASSICS

To mark the 100th anniversary of Verner Panton, Designmuseum Danmark is showcasing some of the most iconic furniture pieces by the celebrated designer. As the 3daysofdesign festival kicks off on 10 June, the museum opens a true Panton universe for visitors to explore throughout the rest of the year.

[Read more](https://designmuseum.dk/en/verner-panton-100-years/)

[EXPERIENCE VERNER PANTON CLASSICS link](https://designmuseum.dk/en/verner-panton-100-years/ 'EXPERIENCE VERNER PANTON CLASSICS link')

# Glyptoteket

## Currently at the Glyptotek

The museum is set to undergo historic restoration.

[Read more about the Glyptotek of the Future](https://glyptoteket.com/explore/the-glyptotek-of-the-future)

**The Power of Fashion in the Roman Empire** is the largest special exhibition on antiquity in the history of the museum.

Step into a world of colour, drapery, magnificent footwear and fabulous hairstyles as the exhibition The Power of Fashion in the Roman Empire explores fashion in antiquity for the very first time. This ambitious special exhibition, extending over more than 1,000 m2 is a first in Denmark and internationally. 1 October 2026 - 29 March 2027.

[Read more](https://glyptoteket.com/whats-on/guided-tours/power-fashion-tour)

### The Winter Garden with its lush palms and iconic glass dome is the centerpiece and landmark of the Glyptotek.

Visit the museum's green heart, from where you are guided to the museum's various exhibitions, café, and shop.

You can also sit down and enjoy the surroundings.

[Architecture](https://glyptoteket.com/explore/architecture)

### Combine your visit with coffee and cake at the café, Picnic.

Visit Picnic and enjoy delicious lunch dishes, desserts, coffee, and other beverages.

[Picnic - Café](https://glyptoteket.com/visit/picnic-cafe)

### Visit the Glyptotek Museum Shop.

Here you will find a large and carefully selected range of products for both adults and children, inspired by the museum's extensive collection, the history of the building, and the museum's current special exhibitions.

[Museum Shop](https://glyptoteket.com/visit/museumshop)

**The city's most beautiful view.**

From the roof terrace above Henning Larsen's building, you can see across Copenhagen and the Glyptotek's varied roof landscape.

The roof terrace is only open when the weather permits.

# [Magical season at Louisiana](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/tracey-emin/)

Open today 11.00 - 18.00

Enter the brave, confessional yet tender world of art icon Tracey Emin in our top rated show. Discover the magical, enigmatic worlds of surrealist painter Remedios Varo and collection highligts in 'Dreams have no title'. Enjoy late autumn vibes in the Sculpture Park and feast on a meal overlooking the sea.

## Current exhibitions

[**Tracey Emin**\\ \\ 8.10.26 - 18.4.27\\ \\ One of the most important figures of contemporary art, Tracey Emin continually challenges boundaries and uses the female body as a powerful tool to explore passion, trauma, pain and healing.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/tracey-emin/) [**Remedios Varo**\\ \\ 18.9.26 - 10.1.27\\ \\ Dream worlds and scientific exploration merge with magical thinking in the Spanish-Mexican painter Remedios Varo's fabulous surreal imagery.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/remedios-varo/) [**Dreams have no title**\\ \\ 23.10.26 - 17.5.27\\ \\ A presentation of selected works from the museum's collection, which includes more than 60 artists and spans a wide range of time - almost exactly 100 years - and is distinctive in expression.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/dreams-have-no-title/) [**700 Nimes Road**\\ \\ 28.4.26 - 10.1.27\\ \\ Sparkling jewels and everyday banality: Catherine Opie's incomparable photo series '700 Nimes Road' from the home of star Elizabeth Taylor.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/700-nimes-road/) [Yayoi Kusama, Gleaming Lights of the Souls,\\ \\ **Kusama installation**\\ \\ Gleaming Lights of the Souls by Yayoi Kusama is one of the most beloved pieces in the museum collection.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/kusama-installation/) [**C.B. Evans: Hyperlinks or...**\\ \\ 23.10.26 - 10.1.27\\ \\ C.B. Evans' seminal work 'Hyperlinks or It Didn't Happen' examines the consequences of the ever closer fusion between the real and the virtual worlds.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/c-b-evans-hyperlinks-or/) [Cleaning the Drapes, photomontage from Martha Roslerr House Beautiful: Bringing the War Home, ca. 1967-72.\\ \\ **Collection in the South Wing**\\ \\ In the South Wing, you can explore a selection of recent acquisitions to Louisiana's Collection. On view are key works by Catherine Opie, Nan Goldin and Martha Rosler – and more.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/collection-in-the-south-wing-2026/) [**Villa & North Wing**\\ \\ The North Wing currently offers a special selection of works from the Louisiana Collection, including several recent acquisitions.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/villa-and-north-wing-2026/) [**Giacometti Gallery**\\ \\ The works of Alberto Giacometti constitute a great pillar of the Louisiana Collection. The museum’s large collection of his original sculptures interplay perfectly with the architecture of Louisiana.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/giacometti-salen/) [**The Concert Hall**\\ \\ In Louisiana's Concert Hall, the museum's guests can experience two significant and gigantic works by Cecily Brown and Per Kirkeby.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/the-concert-hall/) [**Jorn Gallery**\\ \\ Asger Jorn var en gigant i den danske og europæiske efterkrigs-kunst. Hans produktion var vidtfavnende, men i en Louisiana sammenhæng er Jorn først og fremmest maler.\\ \\ About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/jorn-rummet-2026/)

## International membership

Wish to enjoy free entry for a whole year for yourself and a guest of your choice + a get a whole range of membership benefits? [Check out our new **Louisiana International Membership 1+1**](https://louisiana.dk/en/become-a-member/)

**[Sign up for our newsletter in English](https://louisiana.dk/en/newsletter/)**

## With a view of the sea

Visit Louisiana's café and enjoy lunch, afternoon coffee, cake, or dinner with a view of the Sound and the Calder Terrace. With a Louisiana Membership you always get 10% off.

[Read more and see menu](https://louisiana.dk/en/museum/louisiana-cafe/ 'Read more and see menu') [Become a member today](https://louisiana.dk/en/become-a-member/ 'Become a member today')

[**Book a guided tour**\\ \\ Make the most of your visit by pre-booking a Louisiana tour in English\\ \\ Explore the story and architecture of the museum or delve into current exhibitions in the company of Louisiana's skilled arts educators. You can book for a group or choose our exclusive concept: Louisiana for two\\ \\ For booking](https://louisiana.dk/en/whats-on/guided_tours/ 'For booking')

[**Louisiana Evening**\\ \\ A special offer for companies and groups\\ \\ Now you can invite colleagues, associates, networks or partners to a very special Louisiana evening. Here you can experience the atmosphere together, have a guided tour and a snack / light dinner in the Café.\\ \\ Read more and book](https://louisiana.dk/en/plan-your-visit/for-groups-companies/louisiana-evening/ 'Read more and book')

## Lots of fun for little artists

Join us in the Children's Wing

Get creative in our free workshops for children and young people. The Lake Garden also offers plenty of space to play hide-and-seek and whizzing down our famous slide. Children under 18 get free entrance to the museum and all workshops are free.

[More on the Children's Wing](https://louisiana.dk/en/museum/childrens-wing/ 'More on the Children's Wing')

## Creative explorations

Louisiana Art Workshops are perfect for creative and inspirational outings with your colleagues or partners.

Painting, sculpture, drawing or graphic art... Explore the world of art and its processes together with colleagues and partners. With the help of Louisiana's skilled art facilitators, one of our four thematic Art Workshops gives you the opportunity to engage in dialogue with each other in new, informal and thought-provoking ways.

[For more info and booking](https://louisiana.dk/en/plan-your-visit/for-groups-companies/company-visit/ 'For more info and booking')

## Planning a visit?

We have gathered all the necessary information for you when planning your visit. We look forward to welcoming you.

[Read more](https://louisiana.dk/en/plan-your-visit/your-first-visit/)

## A WALK 
IN THE PARK

Nine signature works outside

In the series 'A Walk in the Park', the museum's director Poul Erik Tøjner guides us to a number of the park's signature works. 

The nine short films in the series range from the pop artist Roy Lichtenstein's yellow brushstrokes over Henry Heerup's granite figures to Alicja Kwade's stone globes and Alexander Calder's three masterpieces in front of the café.

[A Walk in the Park](https://vimeo.com/showcase/8376781 'A Walk in the Park ')

Louisiana Channel is a non-profit website that provides culture to the Internet, extending beyond the museum’s own events. The Louisiana team produces videos about art and culture on an ongoing basis. New videos are posted at the site every week.

Videos on the arts, featuring the artists.

[Louisiana Channel](http://channel.louisiana.dk/ 'Louisiana Channel')

Play

In a new interview with Louisiana Channel, artist Issy Wood talks about how she from her studio in London explores desire, self-image, and the ways painting shapes our encounters with images.

## Sustainability at Louisiana

With an ambitious strategy that reaches out to 2050, Louisiana has set itself the goal of contributing actively, solution-oriented and inspired to some of the greatest challenges of our time. Working with both short-term and long-term goals, Louisiana's targeted and strategic work with sustainability have been verified by the Science Based Target initiative and has resulted in a Green Attraction certification.

1.description: Museum Dhondt-Dhaenens is an internationally regarded museum of contemporary and modern art. The Museum is part of Stichting Mevrouw Jules Dhondt-Dhaenens, a Flemish private foundation founded in Deurle in 1967 by Jules and Irma Dhondt-Dhaenens. The Foundation upholds the Dhondt-Dhaenens’ original vision to make their art collection, as well as culture more broadly, accessible to diverse audiences in Flanders, Belgium and internationally. Alongside Museum Dhondt-Dhaenens, the Stichting Mevrouw Jules Dhondt-Dhaenens encompasses two associated sites, the Wunderkammer and Woning Van Wassenhove.

# En anderledes Kulturhusdag – et kig bag kulisserne

[Gå tilbage til oversigt](https://randerskunstmuseum.dk/en-anderledes-kulturhusdag-et-kig-bag-kulisserne/#)

Kom med på en virtuel rundvisning i Kulturhuset, hvor du kan se, hvad der gemmer sig i kulisserne.

Kom med på en virtuel rundvisning i Kulturhuset, hvor du kan se, hvad der gemmer sig i kulisserne.

_Virtuel rundvisning: Kulturhusdag – et kig bag kulisserne, lørdag den 6. marts 2021 kl. 
11 – 11.30._

I årtier har masser af familier sat kryds ved den første lørdag i marts. Her afholdes normalt Kulturhusdag i Randers med gratis shows, teater, koncerter, workshops og meget andet sjovt. Sådan bliver det desværre ikke i år, hvor Covid-19 spænder ben for det store arrangement. Men helt forbigå dagen vil Randers Bibliotek, Museum Østjylland og Randers Kunstmuseum naturligvis ikke!

Markeringen af Kulturhusdagen er nu flyttet til nettet, hvor du lørdag den 6. marts kan komme en tur bag kulisserne og få et indblik i en ellers lukket verden. Du kan komme med på rundturen, som sendes live på Randers Biblioteks hjemmeside, eller på Randers Biblioteks facebookside. Det hele sendes klokken 11, hvor og bibliotekar og museumsfolk sidder klar til at tage imod spørgsmål og kommentarer undervejs.

**Det hemmelige Kulturhus 
**Selvom Kulturhuset er alle borgeres hus, er der samtidig masser af steder i huset, hvor gæster i en normal hverdag ikke kan komme.

“På den virtuelle rundvisning får du et lille indblik i ”det hemmelige Kulturhus”: Hvad gemmer sig bag de lukkede døre og i den gigantiske kælder? Vi har heldigvis masser af historier i huset, der bare venter på at blive vist frem og fortalt, ” lover museumsinspektørerne Anne Sophie Lykke-Poulsen og Lisette Berg Andersen samt bibliotekar Peter Elmelund, der er dine digitale guider denne lørdag.

”Så hurra for de digitale muligheder, som internettet giver os i en ekstraordinær situation som denne i år, hvor Covid-19 stikker en kæp i hjulet også overfor Kulturhusets store, årlige festdag! ”

**Fra kvist til kælder 
**Turen begynder helt bogstaveligt med en på-toppen-oplevelse! Nemlig på Kulturhusets tag, hvor der ikke overraskende er en imponerende udsigt over store dele af Randers by! Derefter står den blandt andet på en tur i byens største elevator ned til Kulturhusets ”katakomber”, nemlig husets kælder, der rummer mange medarbejdere og kontorpladser og nok så interessant: Voldsomme mængder af kunstværker, bøger og historiske genstande, hvoraf der bliver kigget nærmere på et lille udvalg denne dag. Rundturen går blandt andet også til en spritny og endnu ikke åbnet fotoudstilling, til en usædvanlig cykel og en tur op ad en forbudt trappe.

**Kig med 
**”Vi glæder os meget til at ”byde indenfor” til rundvisningen i Kulturhuset den 6. marts og håber, at rigtig mange vil følge med hjemmefra, stille spørgsmål og komme med kommentarer undervejs på turen, ” siger de tre digitale guider for arrangementet og tilføjer:

”På vegne af hele Kulturhusets mange medarbejdere må vi samtidig sige, at vi ser voldsomt meget frem til den første lørdag i marts 2022. Der skal vi tage SÅ meget revanche og igen slå dørene op til et brag af en festlig Kulturhusdag for alle! ”

**Fakta 
**Her kan du følge med lørdag 6. marts 2021 klokken 11 – 11.30: 
[facebook.com/randersbibliotek/live](https://www.facebook.com/randersbibliotek/) 
[facebook.com/museumoj](https://www.facebook.com/Museumoj) 
[facebook.com/randerskunstmuseum](https://www.facebook.com/randerskunstmuseum/) 
[randersbib.dk](https://www.randersbib.dk/) 
Du kan også se videoerne på disse adresser, efter de er blevet sendt.

## **Ateneum Guide enhances your experience**

The Ateneum Guide offers audio descriptions to enrich the exhibition experience of _A Question of Time_. The audio guide works with your phone’s internet browser.

## How do I buy tickets online?

You can buy advance tickets for exhibitions and some events in our webshop. Here you can find answers to the most common questions about buying and using tickets.

## **Explore the entire art collection**

The works in our collection can be explored on the Finnish National Gallery website. You can search for works by title, year, artist’s name, or theme. Copyright-free works can be downloaded.

# Emma Talbot: You Are Not the Centre

****9.10.2026–25.4.2027****

British artist Emma Talbot fills HAM’s grand arched hall with glowing colours, flowing patterns, and poetic handwritten texts. In her works, humans are not placed at the centre of the world, but as part of nature and a larger whole. At the same time, the exhibition _Leena Luostarinen – Misfit_ is on view in HAM’s other arched hall. 

[Read more](https://www.hamhelsinki.fi/en/exhibitions/emma-talbot/)

## **HAM shop**

The newly revamped HAM shop is now open!

A small store full of big finds. At HAM shop, you’ll always discover something new to brighten your day or delight a friend. Welcome to explore and find your favorites!

[HAM shop](https://shop.hamhelsinki.fi/?lang=en)

HAM has a new café! TOVE Café & Bakery offers freshly baked treats, lunch, coffee and wine. Whether you’re heading to one of our exhibitions, winding down afterwards, or just looking for a good coffee, TOVE is here for you.

Follow the café on Instagram:

[TOVE Café & Bakery](https://www.instagram.com/tovecafebakery/)

## Young Artist of the Year 2026 Roope Itälinna

The Young Artist of the Year 2026, Roope Itälinna, depicts young people dancing at raves and clubs with photographic precision, surrounded by coloured lights, haze and electronic music. Alongside nightlife, he explores moments of solitude and withdrawal into one’s inner world in a variety of domestic and public spaces. His paintings capture something essential about youth – what it feels like to live, feel and be young.

Itälinna’s paintings combine the precision of photorealism with minimalist spatial compositions, creating a tense and carefully considered atmosphere. His meticulous and refined painting technique is a defining feature of the works. They are rooted in the artist’s own experiences of rave culture as well as photographs he has taken himself, which he freely develops in a painterly and fictional direction. In recent years, Itälinna has been particularly inspired by films and meaningful encounters with other people. In the exhibition, the old industrial setting enters into a unique dialogue with the subject matter of the works.

[Read more about the exhibition](https://www.tampereentaidemuseo.fi/en/exhibitions/young-artist-of-the-year-2026/)

## The Art Museum building closed 14 June 2026 due to a major renovation

The Tampere Art Museum closed on 14 June 2026 for approximately four years, as the granary building undergoes extensive renovation and a new main building is constructed alongside it.

During the summer, the Tampere Art Museum will present the Art Realm ’26 Biennial in temporary exhibition venues in the Finlayson area and at the Haihara Art Centre. The Young Artist of the Year will also continue to be selected annually.

The new Tampere Art Museum is scheduled to open to the public in 2030.

[**The complete works of Pentti Kaskipuro, all in one volume**\\ \\ 9.3.2026 The Sara Hildén Art Museum has published a significant publication on the art of Pentti Kaskipuro, one of Finland's most renowned graphic artists on the international stage. This comprehensive reference work opens up new perspectives on Kaskipuro's oeuvre.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/the-complete-works-of-pentti-kaskipuro-all-in-one-volume/)

[**Sara Hildén Art Museum opens with a major exhibition by Pentti Kaskipuro**\\ \\ 5.1.2026 Following renovations, the museum will open on January 10 with an exhibition by the graphic artist known as the master of light and shadow.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/sara-hilden-art-museum-opens-with-a-major-exhibition-by-pentti-kaskipuro/)

[**Sara Hildén Art Museum exhibitions in 2026**\\ \\ 5.11.2025 The first exhibition of the year will provide a comprehensive overview of the work of Pentti Kaskipuro, a graphic art master and artist represented in the Sara Hildén Foundation's collection. In the summer, a group exhibition called ‘Freshly Painted’, showcasing the work of young artists.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/sara-hilden-art-museum-exhibitions-in-2026/)

[**Sara Hildén Art Museum's summer exhibition explores phenomena in Finnish visual art**\\ \\ 10.4.2025 Opening on 12 June, the exhibition From the Beginning sheds light on the development, artists and themes of Finnish art from the early 20th century to the present day through the Sara Hildén Foundation's collection.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/sara-hilden-art-museums-summer-exhibition-explores-phenomena-in-finnish-visual-art/)

[**Heikki Marila's major retrospective at the Sara Hildén Art Museum**\\ \\ 7.2.2025 The exhibition, which opens at the Sara Hildén Art Museum on 8 February, presents important stages and turning points in Heikki Marila's oeuvre over the past thirty years. It includes new and previously unseen works.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/heikki-marilas-major-retrospective-at-the-sara-hilden-art-museum/)

[**Maaria Wirkkala's major exhibition at the Sara Hildén Art Museum**\\ \\ 11.10.2024 Maaria Wirkkala's exhibition, which opens on 12 October, is an overview of the artist's career spanning more than 40 years. The exhibition includes variations of old works as well as new works made especially for the exhibition.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/maaria-wirkkalas-major-exhibition-at-the-sara-hilden-art-museum/)

[**Jean-Michel Othoniel's major solo exhibition at the Sara Hildén Art Museum**\\ \\ 16.5.2024 Jean-Michel Othoniel (b. 1964, Saint-Étienne) is one of France's best-known contemporary artists. This summer, the Sara Hildén Art Museum will host his solo exhibition for the first time in the Scandinavia.](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/news/jean-michel-othoniels-major-solo-exhibition-at-the-sara-hilden-art-museum/)

## Collection

The Sara Hildén Foundation comprises over 5,000 works of modern and contemporary art. Highlights include world-famous names such as Joan Miró, Francis Bacon, Paul Klee and Alberto Giacometti. Recent additions include Kiki Smith and Marcel Dzama. The Finnish collection contains an extensive selection of modern and contemporary works by Finland’s leading artists.

[Collection](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/collection/)

## Café Sara

Take a break at the museum’s café. Café Sara serves delicious savoury snacks and pastries baked fresh on the premises.

[Café Sara](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/home/cafe-sara/)

## Sculpture Park

The scenic open-air sculpture gallery outside the museum features 19 outdoor sculptures that engage in an inspirational dialogue with their natural setting. Free admission.

[Sculpture Park](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/home/sculpture-park/)

[Sara Hildén’s life and art](https://www.sarahildenintaidemuseo.fi/en/sara-hildens-life-and-art/)

### OPEN 
1 Sep–31 May Tue–Sun 11am–6 pm 
1 Jun–31 Aug daily 10 am–6 pm

WelcomeSerlachius offers a meeting place for art, stories, and friends who appreciate their high quality. In addition to art, history, and architecture, our guests enjoy food and sauna experiences in a unique setting.

### Serlachius Manor

Joenniementie 47, Mänttä

Built by Gösta Serlachius as his representational home, the manor houses a permanent collection hanging Classic Works of Fine Art at the Manor, extensive spaces for temporary exhibitions, Restaurant Gösta, summer café Autere Cottage, museum shop, and Serlachius Art Sauna.

### Serlachius Headquarters

R. Erik Serlachiuksen katu 2, Mänttä

The permanent exhibition _Patrons_ tells the story of the Serlachius Art Collection and the Mänttä factory community. Located in the centre of Mänttä, the building also has gallery facilities for temporary exhibitions, an experiential space for the whole family, the _World of Forest_, small café and a museum shop.

#### Serlachius Collections

Serlachius’ paper mill owners began collecting art more than a hundred years ago. Today, Serlachius Art collection includes approximately 10,000 works.

The Serlachius Cultural History Collections contain material on the history of Mänttä, the G. A. Serlachius Company and the Serlachius family. They are constantly being accumulated.

[Acquaint yourself with Serlachius Collections](https://serlachius.fi/en/collections-and-museum/)

### SERLACHIUS ART SAUNA

Serlachius Manor, Joenniementie 47, Mänttä

Serlachius Art Sauna offers experiences for lovers of sauna, art, architecture and pure northern lake nature. Communal public sauna days are held every Tuesday, all year round.

Serlachius Art Sauna and its restaurant services are rented out for parties, meetings and evening gatherings.

[Read more and book a shift for public sauna day](https://serlachius.fi/en/serlachius-art-sauna/)

#### Serlachius Residency

Serlachius Residency is a guest studio maintained by the Fine Arts Foundation for creative professionals working in the field of visual arts.

The residency offers a peaceful working environment. We produce small events that enable encounters between the audience and residency guests. Admission to all residency events is free.

[Read more](https://serlachius.fi/en/serlachius-residency/)

#### HIGH-QUALITY ART PRODUCTS FROM THE SERLACHIUS ONLINE STORE

Bring art home! In the Serlachius online store, you will find high-quality, inspiring art products – as gifts, souvenirs, or to delight yourself. Also, remember gift cards!

The Serlachius online store also sells tickets to the museum, the Art Sauna, and various events.

[Enter the online shop](https://shop.serlachius.fi/en_US)

### WELCOME JUST AS YOU ARE

Serlachius is a safe and largely accessible destination also for people with mobility and sensory impairments.

Serlachius is proudly a LGBTQ+ friendly destination, where diversity is richness and every guest can feel safe and valued. We are part of the We Speak Gay community and the Gay Travel Finland network.

## udstillinger

[**Romantiserede Rebeller**\\ \\ Skagensmalernes værker opfattes ofte som smukke, behagelige, og måske en lille smule konservative. Men det er kun den halve sandhed…\\ \\ Læs mere](https://skagensmuseum.dk/udstillinger/romantiserede-rebeller/)

[**Tak for mad – Skagensmalernes spisekammer**\\ \\ Skagensmalerne udødeliggjorde en lille fiskerby i verdenskunsten, men de satte også varige kulturelle aftryk på det levede liv. Ét af de væsentlige…\\ \\ Læs mere](https://skagensmuseum.dk/udstillinger/tak-for-mad/)

## GIV EN GAVE TIL SKAGENS MUSEUM OG GØR EN KÆMPE FORSKEL!

Ved at støtte Skagens Museum med en økonomisk gave bidrager du til, at museet fortsat kan værne om og udbygge verdens største samling af skagensmalernes kunst og skabe oplevelser med udgangspunkt i skagensmalernes livsværk.

[giv donation](https://shop.skagensmuseum.dk/donation/)

[**saxild café**\\ \\ Spis din frokost, nyd din kage og nip til kaffen hos Saxild i Anchers have. I de gule længer serveres klassiske frokostretter…\\ \\ Læs mere](https://skagensmuseum.dk/cafeer/)

[**Bent Vinn Nielsen modtager Drachmannlegatet 2026**\\ \\ Traditionen tro er Holger Drachmanns fødselsdag d. 9. oktober anledning til at afsløre navnet på årets modtager af Drachmannlegatet. I år går…\\ \\ Læs mere](https://skagensmuseum.dk/nyheder/bent-vinn-nielsen-modtager-drachmannlegatet-2026/)

[**Nu slår uret igen i Anchers Hus**\\ \\ Der er sket noget ganske særligt i Anchers Hus. I den venstre stue er et gammelt ur vendt tilbage efter, at det…\\ \\ Læs mere](https://skagensmuseum.dk/nyheder/nu-slaar-uret-igen-i-anchers-hus/)

[**Skagens Museums mangeårige forperson for bestyrelsen takker af**\\ \\ Bjarne Kvist, Skagens Museums forperson for bestyrelsen siden 2018, takker af og overlader posten til Flemming Vogdrup. Derudover indtræder tre nye medlemmer…\\ \\ Læs mere](https://skagensmuseum.dk/nyheder/skagens-museums-mangeaarige-forperson-for-bestyrelsen-takker-af/)

# Museum of Archaeology and Contemporary Art

Museum of Archaeology and Contemporary Art Aboa Vetus Ars Nova is situated in the center of Turku, Finland. Aboa Vetus’ archaeological site and exhibitions tell a story of the city. Ars Nova exhibitions are concentrated on contemporary art and on presenting the museum’s art collection.

## [Discoveries in the heart of Turku](https://avan.fi/en/nayttelyt/aboa-vetus-old-turku)

#### Welcome to the renewed Archaeological Museum Aboa Vetus!

## [Encounters – Works from the Collection](https://avan.fi/en/nayttelyt/matti-rag-paananen 'Matti Rag Paananen')

#### 17 April 2026 –

[Opening hours and tickets](https://avan.fi/en/opening-hours-and-tickets)

**Open Tue–Sun 11–18**

[Opening hours and tickets](https://avan.fi/en/opening-hours-and-tickets)

**Tickets 20 / 14 €**

[Arrival and accessibility](https://avan.fi/en/arrival-and-accessibility)

**Itäinen Rantakatu 4–6**

###### Aboa Vetus

## Old Turku

**The Archaeological Museum Aboa Vetus has been renewed!**

Aboa Vetus, the only archaeological museum in Finland, is a town quarter discovered underground. The ruin area of Aboa Vetus includes the remains of medieval houses. The Convent Riverfront, one of medieval Turku’s main streets, still runs through the museum area today.

[Exhibitions](https://avan.fi/en/nayttelyt/aboa-vetus-old-turku)

###### Ars Nova

## Contemporary art

The Aboa Vetus Ars Nova Foundation Art Collection is a varied assemblage of works from the recent history of Finnish and Western art. The collection’s oldest works date from the end of the 19th century, but the emphasis is on works originating from after the 1950s to the present day.

[Exhibitions](https://avan.fi/en/exhibitions)

### Museum Shop

Aboa Vetus Ars Nova’s Museum Shop is a plentiful gift shop, which is easy to pop in to even without visiting the museums exhibitions. The Museum Shop is known for its abundant collection of postcards, jolly toys and elegant jewellery.

## On view

---

### The Other Side of the Mountain

#### ”Until the lion has their historian, the hunter will always be a hero.” – African proverb

11 artists, nearly 60 works and three new commissions.

The Other side of the Mountain brings together contemporary artists working across the African continent and within the Afro-Nordic diaspora. They explore how cities and modern landscapes shape our connections to one another and to the places we inhabit, creating distance or bringing us closer together.

14 October 2026 – 21 March 2027

[Learn more](https://amosrex.fi/en/exhibitions/the-other-side-of-the-mountain/)

## NEWS

##### NOW

ELIN DANIELSON-GAMBOGI 
Gazes and Encounters 
12 September 2026 – 31 January 2027

ELIN DANIELSON-GAMBOGI (1861–1919) was one of the bold innovators of Finnish visual art. The exhibition Gazes and Encounters explores her work particularly through the perspectives of portraiture, presence, and human relationships.

​

Elin Danielson-Gambogi: Girl and Cats in a Summery Landscape, 1892.

UPM-Kymmene Cultural Foundation

[Read more](https://www.didrichsenmuseum.fi/en/edg)

##### NEWS

Gazes and Encounters 
12 September 2026 – 31 January 2027

​

Opening hours 
Tue–Sun 10 am–6 pm

Mon closed

​

Public guided tours to the exhibition in English on the first Saturday of each month at 12 noon.

​

Photo: Niklas Rosström

[Read more](https://www.didrichsenmuseum.fi/en/liput)

##### MUSEUM, ARCHITECTURE, SCULPTURE PARK

The Didrichsen Art Museum was born out of the love for art. The modern building was designed by architect Viljo Revell and it is located by the sea on Kuusisaari island in western Helsinki. The museum is surrounded by a sculpture park that is open for public during the museum's operating hours. 

[Read more](https://www.didrichsenmuseum.fi/en/didrichsenmuseo)

## EXHIBITIONS

Marie-Louise and Gunnar Didrichsen opened a museum adjacent to their home in 1965. The museum holds three exhibitions each year, most often with a link to the ongoing temporary exhibition.

​

​

[READ MORE](https://www.didrichsenmuseum.fi/en/näyttelyt)

## ​COLLECTIONS

The collection consists of around one thousand items, comprising Finnish and international twentieth-century art, as well as examples from ancient Asian and Latin American cultures. The collection is presented in various combinations in conjunction with the temporary exhibitions

[READ MORE](https://www.didrichsenmuseum.fi/en/kokoelma)

##### MUSEUM SHOP

The exhibition catalogue and other products can be ordered from our webshop.

[READ MORE](https://holvi.com/shop/didrichsen/?lang=en)

« We hope that our museum will remain the home of everything beautiful: art, architecture, nature and music and that it will give others as much joy as it has given us »

​

– Marie-Louise and Gunnar Didrichsen, 1968

​

Pictured: The Didrichsen family in Villa Didrichsen's library

metadata.title: Home | Musée Rodin
metadata.description: Le musée Rodin est un musée assurant depuis 1919 la conservation et la diffusion de l’œuvre d’Auguste Rodin (1840-1917). À travers ses deux sites, l'hôtel Biron de la rue de Varenne dans le 7e arrondissement à Paris et la villa des Brillants à Meudon (Hauts-de-Seine).

headings.text: The must-sees of the Musée Rodin
The news of The Musée Rodin

additionalMeta.abstract: L’établissement conserve une collection composée de près de 6 800 sculptures, 8 000 dessins, 10 000 photographies anciennes et 8 000 autres objets d’art. Avec 700 000 visiteurs par an, le musée Rodin compte parmi les musées français les plus importants.

# [Welcome to the Gallen-Kallela Museum](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/gallen-kallela-museum/)

At the Gallen-Kallela Museum, you will be surrounded by the art of Akseli Gallen-Kallela in the unique cultural environment of Tarvaspää.

In our changing exhibitions we tell the story of one of our country's most important artists, his life and family, not forgetting contemporary art.

Complete your visit by enjoying a treat in our beautiful café, which in summer expands into our museum garden.

[Read more](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/gallen-kallela-museum/)

[Read more about Akseli Gallen-Kallela](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/en-akseli-gallen-kallela/)

[Read more about Tarvaspää studio building](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/studio/)

## Visiting 
the museum

#### Only guide and assistance dogs are welcome in the museum

### Visiting address

Gallen-Kallelan tie 27, 
Espoo, Finland 
+358 10 406 88 40

### Opening hours

**Tue–Fri 11am to 4pm**

**Sat–Su 11am to 5pm**

Guided tours in English Saturdays 3pm

[You can check café opening hours from this link](https://www.cafezoceria.fi/)

[Exceptions to museum opening hours](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/visiting-the-museum/)

### Admission

14 € adults 
9 € pensioners 
7 € students, unemployed

Free entry for under 18 year old.

Finnish Museum Card and Kaikukortti.

We accept Epassi and Edenred as payment methods.

Visit our atmospheric museum café, located in the historic mid-19th century Villa Linudd.

Museum's collections include works of art, artefacts, archival materials and Akseli and Mary Gallen-Kallela's home library.

01.11.2026 - 29.11.2026

Pori Art Museum, Eteläranta

VAIKUTA Weeks at the Pori Art Museum provide a platform for dialogue, participation, and factual information. Bring your meeting, book club, or hobby group into the gallery space to engage with art and fellow visitors. Please register at heidi.porttila@pori.fi.

[Reading Together](https://www.poriartmuseum.fi/en/events/reading-together/)

14.11.2026 - 14.11.2026

13:00 - 15:00

Pori Art Museum, Eteläranta

The Silent Book Club Pori meets at the art museum. Please register with the club organizer via email or Instagram from November 4–12.

[Knitting Together](https://www.poriartmuseum.fi/en/events/knitting-together-3/)

15.11.2026 - 15.11.2026

14:00 - 16:00

Pori Art Museum, Eteläranta

At these meetings, we knit items to donate to charity. Please bring your own yarn and knitting needles. Participation is free of charge for charity knitters.

[Knitting Together](https://www.poriartmuseum.fi/en/events/knitting-together-4/)

22.11.2026 - 22.11.2026

14:00 - 16:00

Pori Art Museum, Eteläranta

[The Kitchen Sink or Waiting for a System´s Update](https://www.poriartmuseum.fi/en/events/the-kitchen-sink-or-waiting-for-a-systems-update/)

11.12.2026

18:00

Kulttuuritalo Annis, Annankatu 6

A four-part play directed and written by Ondi Madete, taking place at Kulttuuritalo Annis. Admission is free, but places are limited. More information about registration will be provided later. The performance is part of the KORSI Commission programme at the Pori Art Museum.

EXHIBITION

## Histories of LandscapeFrom Monet to Hockney (1890-2026)

24 September 2026 - 31 January 2027

The Musée Marmottan Monet and the Musée de Grenoble are jointly presenting an exceptional exhibition devoted to landscape painting from 1890 to the present day. Entitled _Histories of Landscape: From Monet to Hockney (1890–2025)_, it will be on view in Paris from 24 September 2026 to 31 January 2027, then in Grenoble from 5 March to 4 July 2027.

Curated by Pierre Wat, professor at Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne University and is director of the HiCSA research centre, the exhibition will trace the evolution of landscape painting from its nineteenth-century triumph through to its contemporary reinventions. Although the genre appeared to recede in the twentieth century in the face of ideological and historical upheavals, landscape persisted, transformed itself and remained a major force in artistic creation.

As part of the commemorations marking the centenary of Monet’s death, the event will highlight a dialogue between Monet’s work and that twentieth- and twenty-first-century artists.

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/expositions/histories-of-landscape/)

THE UNEXPECTED DIALOGUES

## MONET / SORIANOMaping MONT KOLSÅS

24 September 2026 - 31 January 2027

On the occasion of the 11th opus of _Dialogues inattendus_, American artist Peter Soriano revisits Monet’s winter journey to Norway in 1895. 
With a large wall drawing created especially for the Musée Marmottan Monet, he converses with the snow-covered landscapes that inspired Monet. 
His work reinterprets these Norwegian locales, combining on-the-spot observation with a reflection on the fragility of northern environments.

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/expositions/monet-soriano/)

Podcast

## Claude Monet : a Shared Heritage

To mark the centenary of Claude Monet’s death, the Musée Marmottan Monet invites you to discover _Claude Monet : a shared heritage_, an eight-episode documentary podcast, open to all.

Through the perspectives and testimonies of those who continue to bring his work to life and pass it on today – members of the Académie des beaux-arts, art historians, curators, conservators, restorers, artists, gardeners from Giverny and visitors – this podcast explores the many facets of the Impressionist master’s legacy. A wealth of voices and perspectives that shed light on the richness and enduring relevance of his work.

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/claude-monet-a-shared-heritage/)

## The museum 
and its history

The magnificent townhouse with its perfectly preserved Empire-style decor was once owned by Paul Marmottan and is now home to the Musée Marmottan Monet. In addition to its collection of pre-modern paintings, sculptures and illuminations, it boasts the world’s leading collections of works by Claude Monet and Berthe Morisot. This outstanding Impressionist treasure is further enriched by works from Delacroix, Boudin, Manet, Degas, Caillebotte, Sisley, Pissarro, Gauguin and Rodin, with Chagall representing the modernist period.

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/the-museum/the-museum-and-its-history/)

PERMANENT COLLECTION

## Claude Monet

The Museum houses the world’s biggest collection of works by Monet. Alongside the iconic _Impression, Sunrise_, some hundred masterpieces bequeathed by the painter’s family and close friends offer an unmatched panorama of the art of the leading Impressionist, from landscapes in Argenteuil to Rouen Cathedral and on to a unique ensemble of Water Lilies and views of the garden in Giverny. Come and let Monet’s secret garden work its charm!

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/collections/claude-monet/)

PERMANENT COLLECTION

## Berthe Morisot

Dashingly executed in pastel tones, bucolic scenes, rural landscapes and portraits of “young girls in flower” illustrate the talent of Berthe Morisot, the first woman Impressionist. This ensemble bequeathed by her descendants constitutes the biggest public collection of this artist’s work, unmatched anywhere in the world. It comprises more than 25 oil paintings as well as rare watercolours and pastels. A remarkable collection and a real must for visitors.

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/collections/berthe-morisot/)

privatization

## Private events

Experience a unique event by organising unforgettable dinners, cocktails or breakfasts in the Salle Claude Monet or Salons Marmottan, where your guests can savour our permanent collections and temporary exhibitions in an exclusive setting.

[Discover](https://www.marmottan.fr/en/private-events/)

metadata.description: Le musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon est situé au cœur de la Presqu’île de Lyon, dans le cadre magnifique d’une abbaye du 17e siècle et de son cloître, devenu aujourd’hui un jardin de sculptures. Les collections encyclopédiques du musée présentent en cinq départements et 70 salles, réparties sur 7 000 m2, un panorama de grandes civilisations et d’écoles artistiques de l’Antiquité à nos jours.

# So Cute! The Art of Happiness

Why and how do artworks make us feel so good? With more than 300 masterpieces – paintings, sculptures, photographs, videos, objects, films, books and installations – the exhibition _So Cute! The Art of Happiness_ takes us on a journey through the history of art, from ancient times until today, in search of our feelings.

[Find out more](https://www.louvrelens.fr/en/exhibition/so-cute-the-art-of-happiness/)

# The Comédie-Française at the Louvre-Lens

**From 14 February to 7 December 2026**, the Comédie-Française is visiting the Louvre-Lens. Presented in the museum’s Mezzanine space (-1), the exhibition recounts the creation and development of the little-known painting and sculpture collections of the House of Molière. With some twenty artworks, the presentation offers a new perspective on this important French theatre institution.

[Find out more](https://www.louvrelens.fr/en/exhibition/the-comedie-francaise-at-the-louvre-lens/)

### TItre

An Arbitrary History : Roller Coaster, 2001

#### Sous-titre

Cai Guo-Qiang

Paragraphe

L’artiste Cai Guo-Qiang a conçu cette expérience farfelue : construire des montagnes russes dans un musée ! Les visiteurs étaient réellement invités à monter dans le wagon pour profiter de cette attraction en musique.  

[EN SAVOIR PLUS](https://www.navigart.fr/mac-lyon/artwork/cai-guo-qiang-an-arbitrary-history-roller-coster-80000000001107?page=1&filters=query%3Acai)

### TItre

Truck, 2007

#### Sous-titre

Erwin Wurm

Paragraphe

A funny way to park? With humor, Erwin Wurm uses everyday objects to create his sculptures and photographs. A step aside that transforms reality into a possible enchantment.

[DISCOVER](https://www.mac-lyon.com/en/collection)

La Monte Young & Marian Zazeela, Dream House, 1990. Collection macLYON Photo Blaise Adilon

### TItre

Dream House, 1990

#### Sous-titre

Marian Zazeela et La Monte Young

Paragraphe

Une installation lumineuse et musicale conçue par La Monte Young, pionnier de la notion de musique éternelle. La musique fait réagir de manière infime les mobiles suspendus créés par Marian Zazeela. Pour l’auditeur, l’expérience consiste à s’immerger pleinement dans le son afin d’en percevoir les moindres nuances, offrant ainsi une invitation à la méditation, à l’écoute attentive de soi-même autant que des sons environnants.

[Ticket Office](https://museedartsdenantes.tickeasy.com/fr-FR/accueil)

## The museum & its collections

 Watch the video

At the Musée d'arts de Nantes, **nine centuries of the visual arts**, from the Middle Ages to the present day, are brought together in dialogue throughout the museum. The collections comprise over **14,000 works**, nearly half of which are modern and contemporary. In an architecture that blends yesterday's with today's, the museum offers visitors **a unique view of Western art**, as well as **the bold temporary exhibitions** for which this major museum in Western France is renowned.
